title: Holmes demo
message:
Holmes — DemoCpuBusy
The executor result for `stop_demo_cpu_stress` is: `{"outcome": "Verified action: stop_cpu_stress. Demo CPU job stopped, host CPU below 85% and DemoCpuBusy cleared."}`.

I have completed all the steps of the SOP and successfully resolved the incident.

**Facts:**
- Alert: `DemoCpuBusy` firing.
- `host_cpu_busy_percent`: 99.98%.
- `labstack-demo-cpu.service` was active with 98.4% CPU usage.
- FastAPI probes were healthy (200 OK).

**Proven cause:**
The `labstack-demo-cpu.service` (stress-ng) was intentionally or unintentionally running and consuming nearly 100% of the host CPU.

**Action:**
Executed `stop_demo_cpu_stress` to stop the identified CPU stress job.

**Verification:**
The tool successfully stopped the CPU stress job, verified host CPU usage dropped below 85%, and the `DemoCpuBusy` alert was cleared.

Executor: Verified action: stop_cpu_stress. Demo CPU job stopped, host CPU below 85% and DemoCpuBusy cleared.
